description: Update a scoped control's implementation fields (write — editor+). Identify by scf_id. Only provided fields apply. Material controls: admin for not_applicable. at_risk raises a deficiency.

implementation_status.description: New implementation status (lowercase): not_started, in_progress, implemented, ready_for_review, monitored, not_applicable, at_risk, or deferred. Moving to at_risk raises a deficiency (see scf_list_deficiencies). A material control (catalogue weighting 10, or set material by an admin) can only leave scope through scf_set_scope_override by an admin (other paths 409), and only an admin may mark it not_applicable (403 otherwise).

maturity_level.description: Maturity level with L prefix: L0 Not Performed, L1 Performed, L2 Planned, L3 Well Defined, L4 Quantitatively Controlled, L5 Continuously Improving

scf_id.description: SCF control identifier in DOMAIN-NN format (e.g., 'AST-01', 'GOV-02') — NOT the UUID

selection_reason.description: Justification for scoping decision — required for not_applicable or deferred

name: scf_update_scoped_control
